page_title: EIN 2-0 HEI | Eintracht Frankfurt v Heidenheim 08/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+4' The corner from Florian Pick (Heidenheim) is intercepted by the defence.
90+2' Heidenheim can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+2' Florian Pick (Heidenheim) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Heidenheim will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
90+1' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Eintracht Frankfurt is cautioned for aggressive play. Heidenheim have a free kick.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Dino Toppmoller decides to make a substitution. Hugo Larsson will be replaced by Makoto Hasebe (Eintracht Frankfurt).
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Fares Chaibi leaves the pitch and Hrvoje Smolcic (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on.
88' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
88' Heidenheim concede a free kick following a bad challenge. Eintracht Frankfurt are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
88' Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
85' It looks like Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) may be concussed after that challenge from an opposing player. He’s definitely coming off in line and Frank Schmidt replaces him with Florian Pick.
84' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
84' Denis Thomalla (Heidenheim) volleys the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but one of the defenders blocks his shot.
83' The corner kick from Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
83' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Heidenheim force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
79' The linesman signals that Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
78' Substitution. Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Philipp Max walks off.
78' Frank Schmidt has decided to make a change. Denis Thomalla (Heidenheim) replaces Tim Kleindienst.
78' Substitution. Jan-Niklas Beste walks off the pitch and Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) comes on as a substitute.
77' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) dribbles into the box, but Kevin Muller is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
77' The attendance is 50000.
75' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Heidenheim.
74' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the middle of the goal, but Kevin Trapp pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.

72' 2 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Buta, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt), who beats Kevin Muller with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 2:0.

70' What a chance that is! Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
69' A snap shot by Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) from mid-range towards the middle of the goal catches Kevin Muller flat footed, but he somehow recovers and makes a brilliant save.

68' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Eintracht Frankfurt are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
67' It is time for a substitution. Nacho (Eintracht Frankfurt) is on for Omar Marmoush.
67' Here is a change. Jessic Ngankam is going off and Dino Toppmoller gives the last tactical orders to Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt).
65' Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
65' Heidenheim keep the ball well and push forward with purpose, but here comes an interception from the opposition.
63' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
63' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal and forces the goalkeeper to make a great save. Heidenheim force a corner. They send men into the box.
61' Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a rough challenge and Daniel Schlager blows his whistle for a foul.
60' The Eintracht Frankfurt players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
58' Frank Schmidt prepares a substitution. Norman Theuerkauf is replaced by Adrian Beck (Heidenheim).
57' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
56' Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Now Eintracht Frankfurt have a corner.

56' A dangerous towering header by Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the right post. This corner kick didn't change the score. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
56' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
55' Heidenheim force their opponents to concede a corner. The ball is cleared after Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
53' Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a rough foul. Daniel Schlager stops the game and makes a call. Heidenheim win a free kick.
51' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) touches the ball with his hand.

50' William Joel Pacho Tenorio (Eintracht Frankfurt) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
50' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
49' Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. Eintracht Frankfurt win a corner kick.
48' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
46' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
46' Half-time substitution. Frank Schmidt decided to make a change. Marvin Pieringer is replaced by Nikola Dovedan (Heidenheim).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) offside.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.

42' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) releases a powerful first-time effort from the edge of the box which goes in the direction of the bottom left corner of the target, but the keeper leaps like a salmon to deny him. Excellent goalkeeping!
42' Neat passing move from Eintracht Frankfurt in order to create new attacking opportunities.

39' 1 - 0 What a beautiful moment! Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the bottom left corner. Kevin Muller just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:0.
38' Jessic Ngankam (Eintracht Frankfurt) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the bottom right corner, but Kevin Muller is prepared and dives to thwart him.
37' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
36' Great teamplay by Heidenheim as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
33' Wonderful movement by Eintracht Frankfurt. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
30' Jessic Ngankam (Eintracht Frankfurt) misses the penalty! His poor effort goes well over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
30' Jessic Ngankam (Eintracht Frankfurt) is going to take the penalty!
28' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kevin Muller (Heidenheim) was quite harsh and Daniel Schlager didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
28' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Kevin Muller (Heidenheim). Daniel Schlager saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. PENALTY to Eintracht Frankfurt!
28' Kevin Trapp is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim). Easy save!
27' Daniel Schlager interrupts the game. One of the players from Eintracht Frankfurt won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. A free kick is awarded to Heidenheim.
26' Heidenheim are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
25' Eintracht Frankfurt have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
23' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Daniel Schlager's book.
23' A player from Heidenheim takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Eintracht Frankfurt have a free kick from a promising distance.
21' Heidenheim enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
20' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Heidenheim comes to nothing.
18' Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball has crossed the sideline. Eintracht Frankfurt are taking a throw-in.
17' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
15' Eintracht Frankfurt move the ball around well as they wait for an opportunity to shoot, but the attack is halted as they lose possession.

13' The Heidenheim players keep hold of the ball by exchanging some long passes. One inaccurate pass, however, surrenders possession. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Heidenheim.

12' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) latches on to a lofted pass and strikes the ball! His attempt flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
11' Jessic Ngankam (Eintracht Frankfurt) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Daniel Schlager had an easy-decision to make.
10' Eintracht Frankfurt control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
8' Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires well wide of the left post.

6' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes a shot from the free kick on the edge of the box and the ball sails inches wide of the right post. What a chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
5' A free kick on the edge of the box for Eintracht Frankfurt. Let's see if they'll manage to convert it into a goal.
5' The Eintracht Frankfurt players are stunned as the referee changes his mind following the VAR review. NO PENALTY.
4' Wait a minute! The referee has decided to review the penalty decision using the VAR system.
4' Handball! A player from Heidenheim handled the ball. PENALTY to Eintracht Frankfurt! Let's see who will take responsibility.
3' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
1' An attempted cross from Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) is cleared.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Heidenheim will kick-off.
